title: Rider-Line Credits Already Booked for an Ended Orthodontic Rider — Premium Billing Accounts
content:
**Deduction.** Credits already booked on the rider line are deducted from the credit on an ended Orthodontic Benefit Riders rider funded by a Premium Billing Accounts arrangement. The deduction is taken from the product of the monthly amount and the rider months counted, before anything is added, and that remainder never falls below 0.00.

- Termination credits on the rider line booked since the rider's termination month: their total is deducted.
- If none was, prepay-unearned credits on the rider line booked since then: their total is deducted.
- Otherwise nothing is deducted.

A credit counts as booked since the termination month when the whole calendar months from its booking date to the credit date are no more than the whole calendar months from the rider's termination date to the credit date. Whole calendar months are counted the way an anniversary is counted (a month is complete only when a later month reaches the same day number, and the last day of a shorter month does not complete it).

**Hypothetical cases** (rider ended 30 April; credit date 12 June; reference count 1 whole month).
| Rider-line credits on the ledger | Deducted |
|---|---|
| termination credit 54.70 booked 20 May | 54.70 |
| prepay-unearned credit 105.02 booked 3 June, no termination credit | 105.02 |
| termination credit 54.70 booked 20 May and prepay-unearned credit 105.02 booked 3 June | 54.70 |
| termination credit 27.35 booked 2 February | nothing (4 whole months before the credit date) |
